dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「バイバーイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye-bye~"
dialogues.text: "Bye-bye~"

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp: 「バイバーイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye-bye~"
dialogues.text: "Bye-bye~"

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Bye."
dialogues.text: "Bye."

dialogues.speaker: Tomo-chan
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、また」
dialogues.en: "Later."
dialogues.text: "Later."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、今日も桜公園に行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to the Sakura Park again today."
dialogues.text: "Let's go to the Sakura Park again today."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おう」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
ふたり並んで歩き出す。何となく慣れたような、
そうする事が自然であるような、そんな気がし
た。
dialogues.en:
We started walking side-by-side. It almost seemed like a
custom now.
dialogues.text:
We started walking side-by-side. It almost seemed like a
custom now.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、今さらですけれど、私達のに付き合っ
　てもらっちゃって、良かったんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"But, besides now, is it really okay for you to be doing
this?"
dialogues.text:
"But, besides now, is it really okay for you to be doing
this?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　良かったって、何が？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君は朝倉君で、何かを企んでいたんじゃ
　ないんですか？　卒業パーティー」
dialogues.en:
"You being who you are, I bet you had some plans already,
right? For the graduation party, I mean."
dialogues.text:
"You being who you are, I bet you had some plans already,
right? For the graduation party, I mean."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「企むって……んな、人聞きの悪い」
dialogues.en: "Plans...? I'm not as popular as you think."
dialogues.text: "Plans...? I'm not as popular as you think."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「クリスマスの時だって、朝倉君が裏で動いて
　たって話じゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "You were saying the exact opposite last Christmas."
dialogues.text: "You were saying the exact opposite last Christmas."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやぁ、裏も表も角度もないって」
dialogues.en: "Naah, that wasn't the angle I was aiming at."
dialogues.text: "Naah, that wasn't the angle I was aiming at."

dialogues.jp: 手をひらひらと振る。
dialogues.en: I waved my hand dismissively.
dialogues.text: I waved my hand dismissively.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、あん時は暇だったしな〜。クリスマスだ
　し……」
dialogues.en: "Besides, that time I was just bored~. That Christmas..."
dialogues.text: "Besides, that time I was just bored~. That Christmas..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「クリスマスは、普通は暇じゃありませんよ」
dialogues.en: "It's not exactly normal to be bored during Christmas."
dialogues.text: "It's not exactly normal to be bored during Christmas."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「一部は、ね。別に、野郎相手に騒ぐ気にもな
　れんし」
dialogues.en:
"More or less. Well, at that time I just didn't feel like
being around the usual idiots."
dialogues.text:
"More or less. Well, at that time I just didn't feel like
being around the usual idiots."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「相手が女の子だったら……違うんですか？」
dialogues.en: "But you went with a girl... didn't you?"
dialogues.text: "But you went with a girl... didn't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ま、そりゃ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Well, yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 振り返り、熱っぽい視線に出迎えられた。
dialogues.en:
I turned around to face her, and was met by a questioning
look.
dialogues.text:
I turned around to face her, and was met by a questioning
look.

dialogues.jp: 「……まあ、相手にもよる」
dialogues.en:
"...I don't know if you'd call it going with a girl,
though."
dialogues.text:
"...I don't know if you'd call it going with a girl,
though."

dialogues.jp:
「……って、何でこんな時期に、クリスマスの
　話してんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"...Anyway, why are we talking about Christmas at a time
like this."
dialogues.text:
"...Anyway, why are we talking about Christmas at a time
like this."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもそうですね」
dialogues.en: "I guess so."
dialogues.text: "I guess so."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「卒パの事だけど、俺は、特に何も参加するつ
　もりもなかったよ」
dialogues.en:
"About the graduation party, I wasn't participating in
anything in particular for that."
dialogues.text:
"About the graduation party, I wasn't participating in
anything in particular for that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それはそれで寂しいかもしれないけど、かっ
　たるかったし……」
dialogues.en:
"Although it was a bit lonely seeing all the hustle and
bustle, I thought it was more trouble than it was worth..."
dialogues.text:
"Although it was a bit lonely seeing all the hustle and
bustle, I thought it was more trouble than it was worth..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「けど、今は──」
dialogues.en: "But now--"
dialogues.text: "But now--"

dialogues.jp: 言葉が止まる。
dialogues.en: I stopped in the middle of my sentence.
dialogues.text: I stopped in the middle of my sentence.

dialogues.jp:
風が吹いた。ことりの髪が舞い上がり、桜の匂
いとともに、ことりの甘い香りを届ける。
dialogues.en:
The wind was blowing, making Kotori's hair dance along with
it. Along with the sakura petals, I could smell Kotori's
sweet scent.
dialogues.text:
The wind was blowing, making Kotori's hair dance along with
it. Along with the sakura petals, I could smell Kotori's
sweet scent.

dialogues.jp: 俺は隣に並ぶことりを見つめた。
dialogues.en: I stopped and looked at her figure walking next to me.
dialogues.text: I stopped and looked at her figure walking next to me.

dialogues.jp:
さて、どう言えば、適切に今の心境を伝えられ
るんだろう？
dialogues.en:
Now, how should I phrase this to give the right impression
of what I'm trying to say...
dialogues.text:
Now, how should I phrase this to give the right impression
of what I'm trying to say...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今は──何です？」
dialogues.en: "Now... what?"
dialogues.text: "Now... what?"

dialogues.jp: 俺とことりと。
dialogues.en: Her and I.
dialogues.text: Her and I.

dialogues.jp: 視線がゆっくりと交差する。
dialogues.en: Our eyes crossed paths for what seemed like an eternity.
dialogues.text: Our eyes crossed paths for what seemed like an eternity.

dialogues.jp: 「……そうだな、今は……」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, now..."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, now..."

dialogues.jp:
「こうやってふたりで並んで、春の桜公園を歩
　くことがかなり楽しい」
dialogues.en:
"The two of us walking together in the Sakura Park at
spring... it's great."
dialogues.text:
"The two of us walking together in the Sakura Park at
spring... it's great."

dialogues.jp: それが、今の正直な心境だろう。
dialogues.en: That was how I truly felt now.
dialogues.text: That was how I truly felt now.

dialogues.jp:
好きだとか何だとかは置いておいて、俺は、こ
とりと一緒に時間を過ごしたいと思っている。
dialogues.en:
Whether it meant that I was in love with her or not, I just
knew I wanted to spend more time with her.
dialogues.text:
Whether it meant that I was in love with her or not, I just
knew I wanted to spend more time with her.

dialogues.jp:
「かったるいどころじゃなくて……たとえ風邪
　なんか引いてても、そうしたいくらいに」
dialogues.en:
"It's not troublesome to me anymore... so even if you have a
cold or anything, I don't mind spending time with you."
dialogues.text:
"It's not troublesome to me anymore... so even if you have a
cold or anything, I don't mind spending time with you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私も、同じです」
dialogues.en: "I feel the same way."
dialogues.text: "I feel the same way."

dialogues.jp:
ささやき声。けれどそれは、春風に吹き散らさ
れる事もなく、俺の耳にしっかり届いた。
dialogues.en:
A whispering voice. But as the spring winds had died down,
it reached my ears clearly.
dialogues.text:
A whispering voice. But as the spring winds had died down,
it reached my ears clearly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、今日はちょっと、早めに切り上げさ
　せて下さい。お姉ちゃんと約束があって」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, by the way, today I'd be ending my practice a bit
early. I have a promise with my sister to keep."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, by the way, today I'd be ending my practice a bit
early. I have a promise with my sister to keep."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「へえ、暦先生と？」
dialogues.en: "Heh, with Koyomi-sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Heh, with Koyomi-sensei?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お料理を教えてあげないといけないんです」
dialogues.en: "I promised to teach her how to cook."
dialogues.text: "I promised to teach her how to cook."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「暦先生って料理できないんだ？　……なんか、
　まんまって感じだな」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei can't cook? ...Pretty appropriate, I guess."
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei can't cook? ...Pretty appropriate, I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうかもしれないですね」
dialogues.en: "I don't know about that."
dialogues.text: "I don't know about that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「んでも、何で？　何で、教えを｛こ／請｝う気になっ
　たんだ？」
dialogues.en: "But why? Why did she ask you now to teach her to cook?"
dialogues.text: "But why? Why did she ask you now to teach her to cook?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、う〜……それはですね……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, um... that's because..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, um... that's because..."

dialogues.jp: ごにょごにょと歯切れが悪い。
dialogues.en: Kotori seemed to be uncertain.
dialogues.text: Kotori seemed to be uncertain.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……言っちゃっていいのかな……？　
　まあ、いいよね、朝倉君だし……」
dialogues.en:
"Umm... would it be okay if I said it?... Well, it should be
okay, it's Asakura-kun after all..."
dialogues.text:
"Umm... would it be okay if I said it?... Well, it should be
okay, it's Asakura-kun after all..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何、ぶつくさ呟いてんの？」
dialogues.en: "What are you muttering about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you muttering about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「これは、オフレコですからね」
dialogues.en: "This is off-the-record, you understand."
dialogues.text: "This is off-the-record, you understand."

dialogues.jp:
ぱちんと器用にウインクし、耳元に口を近づけ
てきた。
dialogues.en:
Giving me a little wink, she then brought her mouth close to
my ear.
dialogues.text:
Giving me a little wink, she then brought her mouth close to
my ear.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何よ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　ええっ？　マジで？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? Ehhhhh? Really?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? Ehhhhh? Really?"

dialogues.jp: 顔を離し、ことりの顔をあんぐりと見つめる。
dialogues.en: I jerked my face away and looked at Kotori in shock.
dialogues.text: I jerked my face away and looked at Kotori in shock.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「学園のみんなには内緒ですよ」
dialogues.en: "Keep it a secret from everyone in school!"
dialogues.text: "Keep it a secret from everyone in school!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "A, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "A, ahh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、練習始めましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, let's start practice."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, let's start practice."

dialogues.jp:
とことこと桜の大木に向かう背中を見つめなが
ら、俺は呆然と呟いた。
dialogues.en:
As she disappeared behind the giant sakura tree as usual, I
muttered to myself in amazement.
dialogues.text:
As she disappeared behind the giant sakura tree as usual, I
muttered to myself in amazement.

dialogues.jp: 「暦先生が……結婚とは」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei's... getting married..."
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei's... getting married..."

dialogues.jp: ◆練習の後３◆
dialogues.en: ◆After Practice 3◆
dialogues.text: ◆After Practice 3◆

dialogues.jp:
練習の後、俺達はいつものように桜公園へと向
かった。
dialogues.en:
After practice, we did our usual routine and headed towards
the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text:
After practice, we did our usual routine and headed towards
the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
こうしてことりと二人で過ごす時間は楽しかっ
た。そして、それは同じだとことりも言ってく
れた。
dialogues.en:
I managed to get it out that I enjoyed the time I spent with
her, and (inadvertently?) heard her whisper the same thing.
dialogues.text:
I managed to get it out that I enjoyed the time I spent with
her, and (inadvertently?) heard her whisper the same thing.

dialogues.jp:
練習を始める前に、俺は驚くべき事を聞かされ
てしまった。
dialogues.en:
Just before practice started, I heard something that stunned
me.
dialogues.text:
Just before practice started, I heard something that stunned
me.

dialogues.jp: 暦先生が結婚するらしい。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei was getting married.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei was getting married.
